notes: Contents: p.2-3 list of agrupaciones with departments and seats (147 deputies); p.4 seats per agrupación; pp.5-32 detailed 'Cuadro sinóptico' by comuna/departamento/provincia (party presented/elected/votes over facing pages, totals hábiles/nulos y en blanco/total/inscritos); p.33 one-page summary table 'Cuadro resumen ... conforme con los escrutinios practicados por el Tribunal Calificador', from which all contest figures were transcribed (every row's party votes add to its votos hábiles, every party column adds to its printed national total); pp.34-36 an annex of national party totals for 1941, 1945 and 1949 (the 1949 figures on p.36 equal the p.33 totals). The detailed tables were used to check Tarapacá and Bío-Bío. Contest numbers are sequential: Santiago's 7.a agrupación is split into 1er, 2º (with Talagante) and 3er distritos (contests 7-9), so contest n>=10 is agrupación n-2. No candidate names or preference votes are printed, so candidates lists are empty; 'candidates_presented' is an extra field with the printed Presentados count. National: 412 presented, 147 elected; the p.33 national row reads Conservador 98 118, which agrees with the row sum once Bío-Bío is read as 1 686.
